title: Untitled [Rāmānandī holyman showing the sūrya mudrā]
creator: Prema Goet and Jagadish Das Tyagi
description: A black-and-white photograph depicting a South Asian sādhu (holy man) named Jagadish Das Tyagi of the Rāmānandī Sampradāya, a Vaishnava religious order, showing the Sūrya-mudrā hand-gesture that is used during the practice of dhūnī tapasya.
subject: mudrā; vaishnava; hand; yoga; sādhu; dhūnī tapasya; Hinduism; rāmānandī; yogīn
source: This photograph was taken by Prema Goet during the Kumbha Mela in Ujjain, India, in 2016, and printed at Fotoleutner in Vienna in 2025. It was acquired by Task Force 3 of The Mantrams Project as part of Goet’s doctoral research at the University of Vienna. Between 2025 and 2028, the photograph was exhibited within The Mantrams Project exhibition Dhun-Dhūnī, “The Fires of the Name,” present­ed during the Yoga Darśana Conference – Yoga Darśana, Yoga Sādhana: Authenticity, Authority, and Adaptation in Paris, as well as in an exhibition at the Department of South Asian, Buddhist and Tibet­an Studies at the University of Vienna in 2025.

title: Untitled [Rāmānandī holyman displaying the śīrṣāsana – an inverted yogic posture while practic­ing dhūni-tap, fire penance, religious austerity, tapasya, yoga]
creator: Prema Goet and Sri Ram Balak Das
description: A black-and-white photograph depicting Sri Ram Balak Das, a South Asian sādhu (holy man) of the Rāmānandī Sampradāya, a Vaishnava religious order, engaged in yogic penance (dhūnī tapasya) on the first day of spring in 2019. The religious adept occupies the centre of the image, displaying the śīrṣāsana – an inverted yogic posture while practicing dhūni-tap. He is encircled by a ring of blazing cow-dung fires. Here, the adept practices nām-jap, the repetitive utterance of sacred names such as “Rāma Rāma Rāma Rāma Rāma…”
